-- GQ470_S1A_BOUNDED_BATTLE_GROWTH_TAG_20261123
-- Read only the current server publications. This is not a level/XP authority.
local function watchBattleGrowth(player:Player):()->()
 local retired=false
 local character:Model?=nil
 local head:BasePart?=nil
 local humanoid:Humanoid?=nil
 local rootPart:BasePart?=nil
 local arena:Instance?=nil
 local admittedArena:Instance?=nil
 local tag:BillboardGui?=nil
 local textLabel:TextLabel?=nil
 local playerConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local characterConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local partConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local arenaConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local arrivalConnection:RBXScriptConnection?=nil
 local retiring:{[Instance]:boolean}=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local generation=0
 local stealthEpoch=0
 local stealthDeadline:number?=nil
 local update:()->()=function() end
 local function disconnectAll(connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
  for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  table.clear(connections)
 end
 local function hide()
  if tag then tag:Destroy();tag=nil;textLabel=nil end
 end
 local function cancelArrival()
  if arrivalConnection then arrivalConnection:Disconnect();arrivalConnection=nil end
 end
 local function cancelStealth()
  stealthEpoch+=1;stealthDeadline=nil
 end
 local function current():boolean
  return not retired and player.Parent==Players
   and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)==player
   and character~=nil and player.Character==character
   and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not retiring[character]
 end
 local function selectArena():Instance?
  local mode=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode")
  if mode~="TEAM" and mode~="BATTLE_ROYALE" then return nil end
  local container=workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
  local found=container and container:FindFirstChild(mode.."_Arena")
  if found and found:IsA("Folder") and found.Parent==container and not retiring[found] then return found end
  return nil
 end
 local function bindArena(nextArena:Instance?)
  if arena==nextArena then return end
  disconnectAll(arenaConnections);cancelArrival();cancelStealth();hide()
  arena=nextArena;admittedArena=nil
  if not nextArena then return end
  local captured=nextArena
  local function changed()
   if not retired and arena==captured then update() end
  end
  table.insert(arenaConnections,captured:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(changed))
  table.insert(arenaConnections,captured.AncestryChanged:Connect(changed))
  table.insert(arenaConnections,captured.Destroying:Connect(function()
   retiring[captured]=true
   if not retired and arena==captured then update() end
  end))
 end
 local function validPart(instance:Instance?,className:string):boolean
  return instance~=nil and instance:IsA(className) and instance.Parent==character and not retiring[instance]
 end
 local function bindParts()
  local ch=character
  local nextHead=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
  local nextHumanoid=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local nextRoot=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not validPart(nextHead,"BasePart") then nextHead=nil end
  if not validPart(nextHumanoid,"Humanoid") then nextHumanoid=nil end
  if not validPart(nextRoot,"BasePart") then nextRoot=nil end
  if head==nextHead and humanoid==nextHumanoid and rootPart==nextRoot then return end
  local rootChanged=rootPart~=nextRoot
  disconnectAll(partConnections);cancelArrival();cancelStealth();hide()
  head=nextHead::BasePart?;humanoid=nextHumanoid::Humanoid?;rootPart=nextRoot::BasePart?
  if rootChanged then admittedArena=nil end
  local capturedGeneration=generation
  for _,part in pairs({head,humanoid,rootPart}) do
   local captured=part
   local function changed()
    if not retired and generation==capturedGeneration and character==ch then update() end
   end
   table.insert(partConnections,captured.AncestryChanged:Connect(changed))
   table.insert(partConnections,captured.Destroying:Connect(function()
    retiring[captured]=true;changed()
   end))
  end
  if humanoid then
   table.insert(partConnections,humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
    if not retired and generation==capturedGeneration and character==ch then update() end
   end))
  end
 end
 local function inCurrentArena():boolean
  if not arena or not rootPart then return false end
  local field=arena:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
  if not field or not field:IsA("BasePart") or field.Parent~=arena then return false end
  local point=field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(rootPart.Position)
  return math.abs(point.X)<=field.Size.X*.5 and math.abs(point.Z)<=field.Size.Z*.5
   and math.abs(point.Y)<=120
 end
 update=function()
  if retired then return end
  bindParts();bindArena(selectArena())
  local live=current()
  local active=live and arena~=nil and arena:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")=="ACTIVE"
   and player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive")==true
   and player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated")~=true
  if not active then admittedArena=nil;cancelArrival();cancelStealth();hide();return end
  -- A new avatar starts at the lobby while Host's real .8s return is pending.
  -- Observe this concrete root entering the actual current arena once. Keep
  -- the admission for this avatar/round; no frame poll or arbitrary timer.
  if admittedArena~=arena then
   if rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and inCurrentArena() then
    admittedArena=arena;cancelArrival()
   elseif rootPart and not arrivalConnection then
    local captured=rootPart;local capturedGeneration=generation
    arrivalConnection=captured:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
     if not retired and generation==capturedGeneration and rootPart==captured then update() end
    end)
   end
  end
  local role=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_Role")
  local stage=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage")
  local kos=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_NeutralKOs")
  if admittedArena~=arena or not head or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
   or type(role)~="string" or not roleSet[role]
   or type(stage)~="number" or stage~=math.floor(stage) or stage<1 or stage>3
   or type(kos)~="number" or kos~=kos or kos<0 or kos>=math.huge or kos~=math.floor(kos) then
   cancelStealth();hide();return
  end
  local hiddenUntil=player:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil")
  -- The original server skill writes os.clock()+3, not client/server epoch time.
  if type(hiddenUntil)=="number" and hiddenUntil>os.clock() then
   hide()
   if hiddenUntil<math.huge and stealthDeadline~=hiddenUntil then
    cancelStealth();stealthDeadline=hiddenUntil
    local token=stealthEpoch;local capturedGeneration=generation
    local capturedCharacter=character;local capturedHead=head
    task.delay(math.max(0,hiddenUntil-os.clock())+.01,function()
     if retired or token~=stealthEpoch or generation~=capturedGeneration
      or character~=capturedCharacter or head~=capturedHead or not current() then return end
     stealthDeadline=nil;update()
    end)
   end
   return
  end
  cancelStealth()
  if not tag then
   local bill=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
   bill.Name="EGGRUMBLE_BattleGrowthTag"
   bill.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(178,24)
   bill.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.6,0)
   bill.AlwaysOnTop=false;bill.MaxDistance=72;bill.Enabled=false
   bill.Adornee=head
   local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
   label.Name="BattleGrowthText";label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
   label.BackgroundTransparency=.25;label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(23,34,48)
   label.BorderSizePixel=0;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextSize=12
   label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,238,180);label.TextWrapped=false
   label.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;label.Parent=bill
   tag=bill;textLabel=label;bill.Parent=head
  end
  if textLabel then textLabel.Text=string.format("この試合 B%d｜中立KO%d",stage,kos) end
  tag.Enabled=true
 end
 local function clearCharacter()
  generation+=1;cancelStealth();cancelArrival();hide()
  disconnectAll(characterConnections);disconnectAll(partConnections);disconnectAll(arenaConnections)
  character=nil;head=nil;humanoid=nil;rootPart=nil;arena=nil;admittedArena=nil
 end
 local function bindCharacter(nextCharacter:Model)
  if retired or player.Parent~=Players or player.Character~=nextCharacter then return end
  if character==nextCharacter then update();return end
  clearCharacter();character=nextCharacter
  local capturedGeneration=generation
  local function changed()
   if not retired and generation==capturedGeneration and character==nextCharacter then update() end
  end
  table.insert(characterConnections,nextCharacter.ChildAdded:Connect(changed))
  table.insert(characterConnections,nextCharacter.ChildRemoved:Connect(changed))
  table.insert(characterConnections,nextCharacter.AncestryChanged:Connect(changed))
  table.insert(characterConnections,nextCharacter.Destroying:Connect(function()
   retiring[nextCharacter]=true
   if not retired and generation==capturedGeneration and character==nextCharacter then clearCharacter() end
  end))
  for _,object in ipairs(nextCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
   if object.Name=="EGGRUMBLE_BattleGrowthTag" and object:IsA("BillboardGui") then object:Destroy() end
  end
  update()
 end
 for _,attribute in ipairs({"EGGRUMBLE_Role","EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage","EGGRUMBLE_NeutralKOs",
  "EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive","EGGRUMBLE_QueuedMode","EGGRUMBLE_Eliminated","EGGRUMBLE_StealthUntil"}) do
  table.insert(playerConnections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(update))
 end
 table.insert(playerConnections,player.AncestryChanged:Connect(update))
 table.insert(playerConnections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter))
 table.insert(playerConnections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(oldCharacter)
  if character==oldCharacter then clearCharacter() end
 end))
 if player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character) end
 return function()
  if retired then return end
  retired=true;clearCharacter();disconnectAll(playerConnections)
 end
end
-- GQ470_S1A_BOUNDED_BATTLE_GROWTH_TAG_END

local roleWatchers:{[Player]:any}={}
local function watchRole(player:Player)
 if roleWatchers[player] then return end
 local connections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local record={connections=connections,stopGrowth=nil}
 roleWatchers[player]=record
 for _,attribute in ipairs({"P0DPreviewRole","EGGRUMBLE_SelectedRole","EGGRUMBLE_Role","EGGRUMBLE_LobbyPreviewRole"}) do
  table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function() decorateHeroCharacter(player) end))
 end
 local function onCharacterAdded(character:Model)
  -- Roblox CharacterAdded can run before UpperTorso/Torso is inserted.
  -- One bounded delayed recheck prevents missing all V3 costumes after respawn.
  task.defer(function()
   if roleWatchers[player]==record and player.Parent==Players and player.Character==character then decorateHeroCharacter(player) end
  end)
  task.delay(.35,function()
   if roleWatchers[player]==record and player.Parent==Players and player.Character==character then decorateHeroCharacter(player) end
  end)
 end
 table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
 if player.Character then onCharacterAdded(player.Character) end
 record.stopGrowth=watchBattleGrowth(player)
end

for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchRole(player) end

end)

hunks.new:
local kills:{[string]:number}={}
 -- Own lifecycle connections independently: Host disconnects lifeConnections
 -- before Destroy, which would cancel pending Deferred cleanup callbacks.
 local growthWorld=session.world
 local growthLease={}
 local growthPlayers:{[string]:Player}={}
 local growthConnections:{RBXScriptConnection}={}
 local growthRetired=false
 local function growthRoundLive():boolean
  return not growthRetired and session.world==growthWorld
   and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and session.rules.winner==nil
   and growthWorld.Parent~=nil and growthWorld:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
   and all.Parent==growthWorld
 end
 local function growthCurrentPlayer(id:string):Player?
  local player=growthPlayers[id]
  if not growthRoundLive() or not player or growthPublishedBy[player]~=growthLease
   or player.Parent~=Players or Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)~=player
   or currentHumanForId(id)~=player then return nil end
  return player
 end
 local function growthCreditAllowed(id:string):boolean
  if not growthRoundLive() then return false end
  local castle=session.rules.castles[id]
  -- Preserve the existing real AI/takeover KO ledger; never publish it to
  -- a replacement human who happens to reuse this numeric UserId.
  return castle~=nil and (castle.isAI==true or growthCurrentPlayer(id)~=nil)
 end
 local function growthRetirePlayer(id:string,player:Player)
  if growthPlayers[id]~=player then return end
  growthPlayers[id]=nil
  if growthPublishedBy[player]~=growthLease then return end
  growthPublishedBy[player]=nil
  if player.Parent==Players and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(player.UserId)==player then
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive",false)
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage",1)
   player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleXP",0)
   labelKo(player,0)
  end
 end
 local function growthRetire()
  if growthRetired then return end
  growthRetired=true
  for _,connection in ipairs(growthConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
  table.clear(growthConnections)
  for id,player in pairs(growthPlayers) do growthRetirePlayer(id,player) end
 end
 local function publishBattleGrowth(id:string)
  local player=growthCurrentPlayer(id)
  if not player then return end
  local snapshot=battleGrowthSnapshot(kills[id] or 0)
  player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleStage",snapshot.stage)
  player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_BattleXP",snapshot.xp)
 end
 if growthRoundLive() then
  for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local id=tostring(player.UserId)
   if currentHumanForId(id)==player then
    growthPlayers[id]=player
    growthPublishedBy[player]=growthLease
    labelKo(player,0)
    publishBattleGrowth(id)
    player:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_GrowthActive",true)
   end
  end
  table.insert(growthConnections,growthWorld:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase"):Connect(function()
   if growthWorld:GetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_MatchPhase")~="ACTIVE"
    or not growthRoundLive() then growthRetire() end
  end))
  table.insert(growthConnections,growthWorld.Destroying:Connect(growthRetire))
  table.insert(growthConnections,growthWorld.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(changed:Instance,parent:Instance?)
   if (changed==growthWorld and parent==nil)
    or not growthWorld:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then growthRetire() end
  end))
  table.insert(growthConnections,all.Destroying:Connect(growthRetire))
  table.insert(growthConnections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player:Player)
   growthRetirePlayer(tostring(player.UserId),player)
  end))
 else
  growthRetired=true
 end
